state_ownership.purpose: Sentinel-specific signal and market-state cache only. Portfolio holdings, weights, cash balances and permanent-floor quantities are NOT stored here.
state_ownership.runtime_rule: Every Sentinel run must read portfolio-state.json directly for current BTC quantity, weights, cash, permanent-floor status and allocation inputs.

market_state_freshness.reason: Refreshed 2026-09-18 with current BTC price evidence (~$78.1K), latest complete Sep 17 U.S. spot-BTC ETF net inflow +$159.5M after Sep 15-16 heavy outflows, and same-week Fed/macro tightening evidence. One-day ETF rebound is insufficient to confirm durable demand recovery.

spot_btc_etf_latest_complete_session.resolution: Farside reports Sep 11 total net flow of approximately -13.2M, consistent with SoSoValue-reported approximately -13.2893M. Prior positive figures were not the total-session net flow under the reconciled fund set/definition.

current_market_snapshot.derivatives_note: CoinGlass current page variants show BTC around 77.8K with OI about 52.09B, futures volume about 35.63B and spot volume about 2.38B. A localized current page variant showed about 32.08M of 24h BTC liquidations. liquidity_inflection.invalidation: Fed tightening expectations materially reverse, Treasury yields retreat sustainably below the breakout area, the dollar weakens materially, and BTC/spot demand improve without renewed downside confirmation
liquidity_inflection.latest_note: Macro headwind strengthened during the U.S. session. Reuters reports the U.S. 10Y Treasury yield above 5% (about 5.004%), the dollar index up about 0.6%, Brent around 108-109, and Fed-hike odds around 89%-90%. U.S. equities were risk-off. BTC nevertheless recovered to around 77.8K, so this is a stronger liquidity headwind without confirmed BTC downside breakdown. The Sep 14 ETF session is still incomplete; latest complete Sep 11 flow remains -13.2M.

accumulation_gate.stabilization: PARTIAL_INSUFFICIENT; BTC recovered toward 78K and Sep17 ETF flow turned positive, but persistence is not established
blocking_gaps: Current reliable on-chain valuation evidence remains insufficient
Macro liquidity remains restrictive after the Fed rate hike
Stabilization improved but is not persistent enough to confirm Recovery
accumulation_gate.price_level_policy: No price level is an automatic buy trigger. 72K, 65K, 58K and other levels are observation/scenario references only. Reaching them triggers re-evaluation, not automatic buying; executable buying remains Gate- and stabilization-driven.

distribution.note: No validated bull-top distribution extreme. Macro conditions tightened further, but BTC remains below the 0.5 BTC permanent floor and has no ordinary cycle-sellable inventory regardless.

allocation_gate.rule: Never use this file as a holdings/weights source. Read portfolio-state.json at runtime and recompute the allocation gate. Price levels are observation points only and never substitute for the Accumulation Gate.
allocation_gate.reason: Accumulation Gate NOT_MET. Sep17 ETF inflow and BTC rebound improve stabilization evidence, but persistence is insufficient and macro liquidity remains restrictive. Portfolio balances are read from portfolio-state.json and are not refreshed by Sentinel.

governance_repairs.detail: Removed frozen-72K ladder language from Allocation Gate state and formalized price levels as observation/re-evaluation references only.
Latest-session ETF sign disagreement was marked SOURCE_CONFLICT and excluded from confirmed Gate evidence until reconciled.
Farside and SoSoValue-aligned figures reconcile Sep 11 U.S. spot-BTC ETF total net flow to approximately -13.2M/-13.29M; ETF evidence is restored as confirmed input.

alerts.reason: August CPI and Treasury/Fed-pricing evidence strengthened the tightening headwind while spot BTC demand evidence was weak/uncertain. BTC price stabilization prevented escalation to a downside-liquidation trigger.

Sep 11 total U.S. spot-BTC ETF flow is reconciled near -13.2M/-13.29M across Farside and SoSoValue-aligned reporting, confirming a fourth consecutive outflow session. This strengthens the evidence that stabilization is not yet confirmed but does not change the current NO ACTION verdict.

U.S. 10Y Treasury yield broke above 5%, the dollar strengthened, Brent traded around 108-109 and Fed-hike odds rose toward 89%-90%, while U.S. equities turned risk-off. BTC held/recovered near 77.8K, so this strengthens the macro-liquidity warning but does not confirm a downside liquidation trigger or authorize a capital action.
